request.prompt: Ten seconds in an ultrawide street shot. A silver delivery bicycle with a red crate rolls through an amber shop-window reflection and stops at a curb. The camera stays level and stationary. Keep the bicycle near the middle as wet paving and warm shop windows continue across both sides of the frame. Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text. Use an old dark-painted timber storefront with brick and three plain amber window panes. All fasciae and windows are blank and unlettered. The bicycle and its red crate are visibly in the foreground as amber light reflects on the wet road. No shop signs, words, characters, glyphs, advertising, menus, humans or mannequins.
